core.title: Traditional Iron Art Ring Pull, Acorn IPQBP

text.description_html:
Acorn IPQBP, Traditional Iron Art Swing Pull

The Traditional Iron Art Ring Pull is hearty. It is made out of hand forged iron and is backed by a lifetime finish warranty. The black finish mimics naturally weathered iron for an old world appearance. This swing pull is perfect for all kinds of light weight doors like kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanity drawers, or even on furniture for an antique look.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Traditional Iron Art Ring Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 3-1/8"
  • width: 2-5/8"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
